questions.stem: What does performance in a data lake refer to?
options: The efficiency with which data is stored, retrieved and processed
The number of users who have accounts
The size of the data lake in terabytes
The cost of the cloud subscription
The number of dashboards built on the lake
questions.explanation: Performance in a data lake refers to the efficiency with which data is stored, retrieved and processed.

questions.stem: Why are storage formats such as Parquet or ORC recommended for data lake performance?
options: They store data as plain text for easy reading
They store data in columns, allowing better compression and faster retrieval on large datasets
They require no metadata
They are the only formats supported by cloud storage
They automatically encrypt all data
questions.explanation: Parquet and ORC store data in columns, which allows better compression and faster retrieval, especially for large datasets.

questions.stem: How does data partitioning improve data lake performance?
options: By duplicating every dataset across regions
By converting all data to a single file
By dividing large datasets into smaller parts, such as by time, region or product category, so only the relevant portion is accessed during queries
By deleting old data automatically
By encrypting each dataset separately
questions.explanation: Partitioning divides large datasets into manageable parts, for example by time or region, so that queries touch only the relevant portion of the data.

questions.stem: Which frameworks are named as able to accelerate query performance in a data lake through indexing-style capabilities?
options: AWS S3 and Azure Data Lake
Apache Hive and AWS Glue
Presto and Athena
Apache Hudi and Delta Lake
Flink and Databricks
questions.explanation: Although data lakes are often schema-less, frameworks like Apache Hudi or Delta Lake can accelerate query performance and make data access more efficient.

questions.stem: Which tools are listed for metadata management in a data lake?
options: Parquet, ORC and Avro
Spark, Flink and Presto
S3, Azure Data Lake and Google Cloud Storage
Hudi and Delta Lake
Apache Hive, AWS Glue and Databricks Unity Catalog
questions.explanation: Proper metadata management using tools like Apache Hive, AWS Glue or Databricks Unity Catalog can greatly speed up processing and query execution.

questions.stem: How does caching help data lake performance?
options: Frequently accessed data is stored in cache, significantly reducing retrieval times for repeated queries
It permanently replaces the underlying storage
It compresses data into columns
It partitions data by region
It enforces access policies
questions.explanation: A caching layer stores frequently accessed data so that repeated queries are answered much faster and data access is more responsive.

questions.stem: How do query engines such as Apache Spark, Presto or AWS Athena improve performance on large datasets?
options: By storing all data in memory permanently
By leveraging distributed computing to run queries in parallel
By removing the need for partitioning
By converting SQL into spreadsheets
By limiting each query to one row
questions.explanation: These query engines optimise SQL queries and use distributed computing to run them in parallel, improving overall performance.

questions.stem: What is said about the relationship between data governance and security and data lake performance?
options: They are the single biggest driver of query speed
They always slow the data lake down
They do not directly impact performance, but clear access policies and encryption can prevent bottlenecks and sustain operational efficiency
They are irrelevant to a data lake
They replace the need for metadata management
questions.explanation: Governance and security do not directly affect performance, but maintaining clear access policies and encryption can prevent bottlenecks.

questions.stem: To maintain performance as a data lake scales on platforms such as AWS S3 or Google Cloud Storage, what must scale alongside the data?
options: The number of dashboards
The number of data stewards
The size of the metadata catalogue only
Compute resources
The number of file formats used
questions.explanation: Cloud storage lets capacity grow as needed, but to maintain performance compute resources must scale appropriately with the data.

questions.stem: How does maintaining data quality contribute to data lake performance?
options: It increases the amount of data stored
It removes the need for a processing framework
It makes caching unnecessary
It requires more transformations to be run
Clean, high-quality data reduces the need for time-consuming transformations or error handling, speeding up processing
questions.explanation: High-quality, clean data reduces the need for time-consuming transformations or error handling, which speeds up data processing.
